verification_limits: Full-day logs and boundary headers match NodeReal and NOWNodes. NOWNodes did not serve individual audited receipts or historic first-funding transactions; those were verified on NodeReal only.

Zero balance and nonce is not an exhaustive proof against historical transient contract funding and destruction. First-activity binary search relies on ordinary EOA history before activity; delegated execution is traced explicitly.
Economic purpose and actual common ownership cannot be established by first-funder matching.
